scope: model-free analysis of author-supplied saved predictions
interpretation: The equal total image weight is distributed as 1/R among its available raters.
Scaling changes interval midpoint-relative half-widths, not point predictions; endpoints are not clipped.
Bootstrap intervals condition on fitted coefficients and exclude their estimation uncertainty.
Within-pass and between-pass are model-process components, not identified physical noise sources.
These computations provide no fresh-cohort or finite-sample coverage guarantee, external validation, or clinical benefit claim.
No model training, image inference, or research-data reproduction was performed by this program.
